verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine and tool-calling model, marketed with an "Automation Foundation Model", so user-defined event-triggered rules is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence shows only single natural-language-to-tool-call mapping and built-in confidence-based cloud routing, not a documented way to define rules that fire actions on events. Developer primitives like decorated tool functions and transcription streaming are building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
